ov: Small carnivores of Africa, Asia and southern Europe, 34 species in two subfamilies. A large introduced population lives in Hawaii.
rg: Africa, Asia and southern Europe; introduced to Hawaii.
df: Mainly insects, rodents, reptiles and birds.

cf.tip: The meerkat is a small mongoose from southern Africa.

fx: Its name comes from Indian languages, altered to end in “-goose” by folk etymology.
notes: Group entry. The existing fact is half confirmed: mongooses have mutated nerve receptors that stop snake venom binding, but "fast enough to fight one and win" isn’t in the article. Suggested wording: "Its nerve receptors are mutated so that cobra venom can’t bind to them." REGION: the source adds southern Europe. Consider adding Europe.
